name: Slice

sections.heading: Logical layout
sections.text: A 40-byte descriptor aligned to 8 bytes in the current native profile. The view cannot outlive its owner or survive forbidden mutation/reset.

sections.heading: Construction and members
sections.text: borrowShared().asSlice() in the measured ownership profile; release derived views before the owner.

sections.heading: Protocols and ownership
sections.text: A Slice borrows its owner and records the admitted view extent/generation. It cannot escape the owner scope; release derived views before the originating borrow. A shared view excludes forbidden writes, while a unique borrow excludes aliases. The descriptor is not an owning clone.

sections.heading: Errors, limits and target
sections.text: Use x86_64 Linux System V ELF for the executed examples. Incompatible types reject before publication; bounds and ownership checks precede an invalid read, mutation or drop. Internal descriptor layouts are not portable ABI promises.

summary: A borrowed view constrained by its owner and generation.
title: Slice
